fields.text: Asked on the board; the form above records your answer here.
only if this means we keep all the data that's on the board though if there's data on the board we'd lose i will want that to get into the repo lmk

Checking first. Everything the board shows per lane is already on master under docs/superpowers/records/<plan>/ (ledger, briefs, reports, reviews, activity log). What lives only in the worktrees: the SDD review packages (.diff files derived from git) and any record line appended after a lane's last commit. I am diffing each worktree's record against master now, will commit any difference to master, then remove the landed worktrees and delete the lane branches locally and on origin. I will reply here with the list before deleting.

Done. Checked every landed lane's record directory against master first: only the old dev-board record differed (two lines that belonged to another lane, now removed), so nothing was lost; the SDD review packages were derived .diff files and are gone with the worktrees. Removed 16 worktrees, deleted their lane/* branches locally and on origin. Kept: board-activity (the board's working lane) and unikraft-linuxu (running, from q4).
